```{r}
# Read the files from circexplorer3 folder
path <- 'D:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/all_quant_files/'
#list.files(path)
circexplorer_files <- sort(list.files(path,pattern= "_" ,full.names=TRUE))
circexplorer_files_list <- list()
for (i in 1:length(circexplorer_files)){

    bsjbgi <- read.csv( as.character(circexplorer_files[i]) , sep= "\t", header = TRUE)
      colnames(bsjbgi) <- c("chrom","start","end","name","score",
                      "strand","thickStart","thickEnd","itemRgb",
                      "exonCount","exonSizes","exonOffsets","readNumber",
                      "circType","geneName","isoformName","index",
                      "flankIntron","FPBcirc","FBPlinear","CIRCscore")
      
  circexplorer_files_list[[basename(as.character(circexplorer_files[i]))]] <- bsjbgi
}

```

```{r}
path <- 'D:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/'
# Generate a big table
tabla_readnum <- data.frame()
tabla <- data.frame()

for (i in 1:length(circexplorer_files)){
  tabla<-as.data.frame((circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$chrom))
  tabla[,2]<-as.data.frame((as.numeric(as.character(circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$start))))
  tabla[,3]<-as.data.frame((circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$end))
  tabla[,4]<-as.data.frame((circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$readNumber))
  tabla[,5]<-basename(as.character(circexplorer_files[[i]]))
  tabla[,6] <- as.data.frame((circexplorer_files_list[[i]]$geneName))
  tabla_readnum<-rbind(tabla,tabla_readnum)
}

#crea una columna con el ID del circRNA
tabla_readnum[,7] <- paste0(tabla_readnum[,1],":",tabla_readnum[,2],"|",tabla_readnum[,3])

# reordena la tabla
tabla_readnum <-tabla_readnum[,c(5,7,4,6)]
#renombra las columnas de la tabla 
colnames(tabla_readnum) <- c("sample","circRNA_ID","readNumber","geneName")

tabla_readnum_2 <- tabla_readnum[,c(2,4)]
tabla_readnum_2 <- tabla_readnum_2[!duplicated(tabla_readnum_2$circRNA_ID),]

tabla_readnum_3 <- tabla_readnum_2[,1]

write.table(tabla_readnum_2,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_circexp3_parental_gene.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)

write.table(tabla_readnum_3,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/circRNA_ID_circexp3.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)

```

```{r}
path <- 'E:/45_circRNAs_seba/01_circexp3/'
#Creando la matriz de cuentas
count_matrix <- tabla_readnum
#Filtro por numero de cuentas 
count_matrix <- count_matrix[count_matrix$readNumber > 2,]

colnames(count_matrix) <- c("sample","circRNA_ID","readNumber")
count_matrix <- count_matrix[order(count_matrix[,1]),]
repeted<-count_matrix[duplicated(count_matrix[,c('circRNA_ID',"sample")]),]
count_matrix<-count_matrix[!duplicated(count_matrix[,c('circRNA_ID',"sample","readNumber")]),]
count_matrix<-count_matrix[,c(1,2,3)]
#Expresa la matriz en formato wide
count_matrix_wide <- reshape(count_matrix, idvar = "circRNA_ID", timevar ="sample", direction ="wide")
#donde faltan valores se agrega un cero
count_matrix_wide[is.na(count_matrix_wide)] <- 0
# Se pone la columna de los nombres como rownames
count_matrix_wide2 <- count_matrix_wide[,-1]
rownames(count_matrix_wide2) <- count_matrix_wide[,1]
# Suma 1 a todos los reads
count_matrix_wide2<-count_matrix_wide2+1

#ordena las muestras en la matriz 
colnames(count_matrix_wide2) <- c("c24_1","c24_2","c24_3","c24_4","c6_1","c6_2","c6_3","c6_4","n24_1","n24_2","n24_3","n24_4","n6_1","n6_2","n6_3","n6_4")

cm_6_c_n <- count_matrix_wide2[,c(5,6,7,8,13,14,15,16)]
cm_24_c_n <- count_matrix_wide2[,c(1,2,3,4,9,10,11,12)]


dir.create(paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results"))
write.table(count_matrix_wide2,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/count_matrix_circexp3.txt"), sep="\t", quote = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# Assign condition (affected versus unaffected), you can assign any name, just keep the number of conditions
stimulus <- factor(rep(c("c6","n6"), each = 4))
# set a datframe with factors
batch = factor(c("Batch1", "Batch2", "Batch3", "Batch4", "Batch1", "Batch2", "Batch3", "Batch4"))

# Crear coldata con condición y batch
coldata = data.frame(row.names = colnames(cm_6_c_n), stimulus, batch)
coldata

#devtools::install_github("zhangyuqing/sva-devel")
library(sva)
combat_counts <- ComBat_seq(counts = cm_6_c_n, batch = coldata$batch, group = stimulus)

```



```{r}
library(DESeq2)

stimulus <- factor(rep(c("c6","n6"), each = 4))
# set a datframe with factors
targets <- data.frame(stimulus)

dds=DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(combat_counts,coldata,design=~stimulus)

# Look the factors and columns
colData(dds)[1:8,]
dds$stimulus = relevel(dds$stimulus, "c6")

dds <- DESeq(dds) 
resultsNames(dds)

#Get_Normalized_counts
dds2 <- estimateSizeFactors(dds)
dds2_norm<- counts(dds2, normalized=TRUE)
dds2_norm<-as.data.frame(dds2_norm)
setDT(dds2_norm, keep.rownames = TRUE)[]
write.table(dds2_norm,paste0(path,"/ciri_DEseq2_comparison_results/normalized_deseq2_count_matrix_cexp3_6.txt"), sep="\t", quote = FALSE,row.names = F)


Res1 = results(dds, contrast=c("stimulus","n6","c6"))
Res2 <- as.data.frame(Res1)
Res2<-na.omit(Res2)
setDT(Res2, keep.rownames = TRUE)[]

library(dplyr)
Res3 <- mutate(Res2 ,Regulation = 
                 ifelse(Res2$pvalue < 0.05 & Res2$log2FoldChange > 1,"Up",
                        ifelse(Res2$pvalue < 0.05 & Res2$log2FoldChange < -1,"Down","Unchanged"
                        )))

library(ggplot2)
Grafico1 <-ggplot(Res3, aes(x= log2FoldChange, 
                            y= -log10(pvalue), 
                            colour=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7, size=2) +
  xlab(paste("log2(FoldChange)")) +
  ylab("-log10(pval)") +
  xlim(c(-5, 5)) + 
  ylim(c(0, 5)) +
      ggtitle("NE_stimulus_6")+
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Up"= "red","Down"="blue","Unchanged"="darkgray"))+
  guides(color = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))+
  labs(fill = "Regulation")+
  theme_bw()

print(Grafico1)

cm_6_c_n_DE <- Res3

cm_6_c_n_DE_ann <- merge(cm_6_c_n_DE,tabla_readnum_2,by.x="rn", by.y="circRNA_ID",all.x=T)
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2 <- cm_6_c_n_DE_ann[order(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann$log2FoldChange, decreasing = T),]
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3 <- cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2[cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2$Regulation!="Unchanged",]
cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_4<- as.data.frame(table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3$Regulation))

#Save_table
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_2,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_DE_ann.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_3,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)
write.table(cm_6_c_n_DE_ann_4,paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/6_c_n_only_DE_ann_numbers.txt"), sep="\t",quote=FALSE,col.names = T,row.names = F)

#Save Volcano
cairo_pdf(paste0(path,"/circexp3_DEseq2_comparison_results/Volcano_c6_n6.pdf"),width = 6,height = 6)
print(Grafico1)
dev.off()
```
